answer: Submitting an answer locks 59 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The sparrow escrow is released only against a ridge receipt, and the willow audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 297 aliases means carrying 200 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 26 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
